reason: Review of the committed pre-registration (commit 4220c46) found gaps in sampling seeds, rule order, what the comparison is between, and how strong a claim each outcome allows.

changes.sampling_seed: Candidate generation (20 per target) uses a fixed sampling seed equal to the run's training seed (42, 43, 44). The seed, library versions and GPU type are recorded per run. GPU kernels may still be non-deterministic; that remaining variation is part of what the repeated seeds measure.
changes.comparison: Every comparison is between our own runs, trained, sampled and scored with the same pinned code and settings. The paper's numbers (8 and 3) are used only for the G0 runner check.
changes.rule_order: Rules are applied in this order and the first that matches decides: G0_runner, not_reproduced, template_specific, data_amount, otherwise (inconclusive). data_amount also covers the case where R scores below PEROV.
changes.claim_scope: template_specific supports only that removing these particular structures may matter beyond their number, for EquiCSP on these 11 targets. It does not establish a causal mechanism (for example the paper's degeneracy explanation). data_amount supports only that this experiment cannot tell the two apart from training-set size. Inconclusive is reported as inconclusive and is not assigned to either reading.
changes.approvals: The 1,000-step smoke test and the full training runs are approved separately.
